_comment: shinogi renderer (change: shinogi-renderer): composes the public shinogi.dev edition from stores already on disk, read-only, and publishes it into a second checkout when the content hash changes. No provider call, no model call, no chain call. Atlas writes shinogi; shinogi is never read back. Rollback: enabled false stops compose and publish and touches nothing else; publish false composes and writes nothing. The push stays false until the Pi has a write credential for vanlabs-dev/shinogi.
